id.meaning: Schedule id from the old HTTP path, also the CLI positional id.

schedule.meaning: The schedule row, including enabled, calendar, frequency, time, weekday, band, action, max_seconds, registered_at, updated_at, last_fired_slot, envelope and raw_envelope; null if absent.

next_fire.meaning: Next local fire as RFC3339 when enabled and calculable; otherwise null.

last_fire.meaning: Stored fire with fire_id, trigger, state, queued_at, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, first_missing_signal, rsync_exit_code, final_file_count and final_total_bytes, or null.

baseline.meaning: Prior sync baseline with fileCount, totalBytes, updated_at and fire_id, or null.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite or filesystem error text> and <stored JSON parser error text>.
